adjudication.rationale: In `.env.example`, `CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY` is documented as "must be 32 bytes for AES256" but the suggested command is `openssl rand -base64 24`, which generates 24 bytes of raw key material (base64-encoded). The new webhook handler (`apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts`) unconditionally calls `symmetricDecrypt(reqBody.keys, process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY || "")` with no length/format validation, so a self-hoster following the provided instructions is very likely to configure an invalid-length key for AES-256 and trigger runtime decryption failures, breaking the credential sync flow.
